conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm and I want to get someone out, and I'd like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.
Booking the service visit is handled separately, so I'll focus on the plan question.

Per the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club members get these benefits on Standard, which is $189 per year per system or $16.99 per month: two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling ahead of non-members, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, annual reminder and filter-change notifications, and $500 off any full system replacement.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system and adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
The documents do not say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day you join, and they do not say whether the plan would save you money on this repair.
A team member confirms whether the benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining when setting up the membership.
To look up your account, please give me your full name and one of the following: your account number, your service address, or your phone number.

I've passed this to our team: Ticket #1. Someone will contact you within one business day. So the team can reach you, please tell me your name and your account number, phone number or service address. You can keep asking me other questions here.
Omar Martinez, 2452 Windcrest Ave, Pflugerville.
Thanks, Omar.

For your AC repair visit, here are the openings I have:

Monday, October 19, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM for an HVAC repair, Monday, October 19, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM for an HVAC repair, or Monday, October 19, 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM for an HVAC repair.
Which one suits you?
So it pays for itself basically.
I can't say it would pay for itself, because the documents don't say whether the plan would save you money on this repair.

Per the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups a year, and the 2026 Repair Price Book (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv) lists the $129 seasonal tune-up as included for members.

Per the same overview, members also get priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, annual reminder and filter-change notifications, and $500 off any full system replacement (also in services/service_catalog.md).
The documents do not say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day you join, so a team member confirms that when setting up the membership.
Whenever you're ready, I can take you back to choosing your Monday time slot.
Yeah, add it and book the visit.
I can't add the membership or book the visit in this reply, so I'm not able to confirm either one here.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Once you're ready, I can take you back to choosing your Monday time slot.
I've added that to Ticket #1; our team will contact you within one business day.
Book it.
To book the visit, I need you to pick a time.
Here are the openings for your HVAC repair: Monday, October 19, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, Monday, October 19, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, or Monday, October 19, 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Which one suits you, or what other time works?
Can you hear me okay?
Yes, I can read you fine.

To book the visit, I just need you to pick one of these openings for your HVAC repair: Monday, October 19, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, Monday, October 19, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, or Monday, October 19, 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Which one suits you?
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.
